ko: 나 주의 믿음 갖고 홀로 걸어도
나 주의 믿음 갖고 실망치 않네
en: I just keep trusting my Lord as I walk a longI just keep trusting my Lord and He gives a song

ko: 나 주의 믿음 갖고 실망치 않네
en: Though the storm clouds darken the sky o'er the heav'nly trailI just keep trusting my Lord, He will never fail
He's a faithful friend, such a faithful friendI can count on Him to the very end
